name: Radiance Field Decoding with Hybrid Features
definition: A modular rendering MLP D that predicts color c and density σ for any arbitrary 3D location x and viewing direction d, conditioned on triplane features ftp and residual local features fr, instead of just positions and viewing directions.
summary: Radiance Field Decoding with Hybrid Features predicts volume density and color using structured global triplane features and local residuals, enabling effective 360-degree view synthesis from minimal input views.
